title: Job-to-Node Allocator seam
summary: The allocator may require evidence that a node supports the secure Queue Transport path, but it does not implement the encryption. Model secure Queue Transport as a durable node ability such as QUEUE_SECURE_TRANSPORT_V2 and make it a hard job requirement when dispatch depends on it.
invariants: Secure transport capability is hard eligibility, not a score bonus.
Capacity, cost, fitness or ranking must not compensate for the absence of a required secure-transport ability.
The allocator advertises/selects capability; Queue Fabric owns the transport implementation and proof behavior.

provenance.claim: Allocator relationship defines QUEUE_SECURE_TRANSPORT_V2 as a hard ability and keeps encryption out of allocator.
Validation restates the allocator boundary and hard-requirement semantics.
